Tygerberg Hospital Neonatal & Pediatric Isolation ICU [6179]

By: John Webb | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Tonight on CB: We go behind the scenes of the CBMAD Trust's latest project, the Tygerberg Hospital Neonatal & Pediatric Isolation ICU.

Summary:
We meet Sister Baartman, a long-serving member of Tygerberg Hospital’s often under-valued nursing staff. She’s worked in the pediatric unit for ______ years, indispensable to the doctors and other staff selflessly committed to saving young lives. For Sister Baartman and other staff, things have been difficult in recent years. The public health system is under strain, and they have to rely on every ounce of their ingenuity to continue delivering world class care to their little patients.

But things are about to change, thanks to the extraordinary efforts of the Carte Blanche Making a Difference Campaign. Our contractors have been hard at work putting the money donated by our ever-generous patrons to extraordinary use. This is the story of the handover to Tygerberg of a state-of-the-art neonatal and pediatric Isolation ICU and how it’ll change the life of committed public health professional like Sister Baartman, and save the lives of babies and children.
